angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 321,413 km at 37.61 pc = 0.11 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 26.5893 +/- 0.0192 mas (same row, RUWE 1.18): 37.61 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.462 +/- 0.013 solar radii from Egger et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1685 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...696A..28E/abstract): 321,413 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.466 +/- 0.019 solar masses from Egger et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1685 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...696A..28E/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3470 +/- 102 K from Egger et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1685 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...696A..28E/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Egger et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1685 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...696A..28E/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1685.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.777, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1685 (pscomppars): spectral type M3 V, from Egger et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...696A..28E/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1685 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.01 dex, from Egger et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...696A..28E/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1685 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.51856, from Luque & Pallé 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022Sci...377.1211L/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1685 (pscomppars): age 1.4 Gyr, from Egger et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...696A..28E/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1685 (pscomppars): rotation period 18.66 d, from Luque & Pallé 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022Sci...377.1211L/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1685 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2 km/s, from Egger et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...696A..28E/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
